title: Function
summary: A function assigns exactly one output to each permitted input.

content.plain: A function assigns exactly one output to each permitted input.
content.exact: A function f:X→Y may be represented by a relation f⊆X×Y such that every x∈X occurs in exactly one pair (x,y) with y∈Y.
content.example: f(n)=n+1 defines a function from integers to integers.
content.caveat: A rule, graph, program, and extensional mapping can represent a function differently.
